sentences.en: Today we're going to look at an important area of science, namely nanotechnology.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨科学领域的一个重要方面，即纳米技术。

sentences.en: So what is it?
sentences.zh: 那么，它究竟是什么呢？

sentences.en: Nano means tiny, so it's science and engineering on the scale of atoms and molecules.
sentences.zh: nano 意为‘极小’，因此纳米技术就是在原子和分子尺度上开展的科学与工程。

sentences.en: The idea is that by controlling and rearranging atoms, you can literally create anything.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是：通过控制和重新排列原子，你实际上可以创造出任何东西。

sentences.en: However, as we'll see, the science of the small has some big implications affecting us in many ways.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我们即将看到的那样，微观尺度的科学却具有一些影响深远的重大意义，并以多种方式影响着我们。

sentences.en: There's no doubt that nanotechnology promises so much for civilisation.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，纳米技术为人类文明带来了巨大前景。

sentences.en: However, all new technologies have their teething problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，所有新兴技术在发展初期都会遇到一些问题。

sentences.en: And with nanotechnology, society often gets the wrong idea about its capabilities.
sentences.zh: 而在纳米技术领域，社会往往对其能力存在误解。

sentences.en: Numerous science-fiction books and movies have raised people's fears about nanotechnology - with scenarios such as inserting little nano-robots into your body that monitor everything you do without you realising it, or self-replicating nano-robots that eventually take over the world.
sentences.zh: 大量科幻小说和电影加剧了公众对纳米技术的担忧——例如将微型纳米机器人注入人体，持续监控你的一举一动而你却浑然不觉；又或出现能自我复制的纳米机器人，最终接管整个世界。

sentences.en: So how do we safeguard such a potentially powerful technology?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该如何保障这种潜在威力巨大的技术的安全呢？

sentences.en: Some scientists.
sentences.zh: 一些科学家。

sentences.en: recommend that nano-particles be treated as new chemicals with separate safety tests and clear labelling.
sentences.zh: 建议将纳米颗粒视作新型化学品，须进行独立的安全性测试并明确标注。

sentences.en: They believe that greater care should also be taken with nano-particles in laboratories and factories.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，在实验室和工厂中也应对纳米颗粒采取更严格的防护措施。

sentences.en: Others have called for a withdrawal of new nano products such as cosmetics and a temporary halt to many kinds of nanotech research.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则呼吁暂停推出新型纳米产品（如化妆品），并暂时中止多种类型的纳米技术研究。

sentences.en: But as far as I'm concerned there's a need to plough ahead with the discoveries and applications of nanotechnology.
sentences.zh: 但就我个人而言，我们必须持续推进纳米技术的发现与应用。

sentences.en: I really believe that most scientists would welcome a way to guard against unethical uses of such technology.
sentences.zh: 我坚信，大多数科学家都乐于接受一种防范该技术被滥用的机制。

sentences.en: We can't go around thinking that all innovation is bad, all advancement is bad.
sentences.zh: 我们不能一味认为所有创新都是有害的，所有进步都是错误的。

sentences.en: As with the debate about any new technology, it s how you use it that's important.
sentences.zh: 正如围绕任何新兴技术所展开的讨论一样，关键在于我们如何使用它。

sentences.en: So let's look at some of its possible uses.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看一看它的一些潜在用途。

sentences.en: Audioscripts Thanks to nanotechnology, there a could be a major breakthrough in the field of transportation with the production of more durable metals.
sentences.zh: 得益于纳米技术，交通运输领域可能会迎来重大突破，从而生产出更耐用的金属。

sentences.en: These could be virtually unbreakable, lighter and much more pliable leading to planes that are 50 times lighter than at present.
sentences.zh: 这些金属几乎坚不可摧、更轻且更具延展性，从而使飞机的重量降至目前的五十分之一。

sentences.en: Those same improved capabilities will dramatically reduce the cost of travelling.
sentences.zh: 同样的性能提升将大幅降低旅行成本。

sentences.en: into space making it more accessible to ordinary people and opening up a totally new holiday destination.
sentences.zh: 进入太空的成本也将因此降低，使普通人更容易前往太空，并开辟一个全新的度假目的地。

sentences.en: In terms of technology, the computer industry will be able to shrink computer parts down to minute sizes.
sentences.zh: 在技术方面，计算机行业将能把计算机零部件缩小至极小的尺寸。

sentences.en: We need nanotechnology in order to create a new generation of computers.
sentences.zh: 我们需要纳米技术来创造新一代计算机。

sentences.en: that will work even faster and will have a million times more memory but will be about the size of a sugar cube.
sentences.zh: 这种新型计算机运行速度更快，内存容量高达现有计算机的一百万倍，而体积仅相当于一颗方糖大小。

sentences.en: Nanotechnology could also revolutionise the way that we generate power.
sentences.zh: 纳米技术还可能彻底改变我们发电的方式。

sentences.en: The cost of solar cells will be drastically reduced so harnessing this energy will be.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池的成本将大幅下降，因此利用这种能源将变得

sentences.en: far more economical than at present.
sentences.zh: 比现在经济得多。

sentences.en: But nanotechnology has much wider applications than this and could have an enormous impact on our environment.
sentences.zh: 但纳米技术的应用远不止于此，它还可能对我们的环境产生巨大影响。

sentences.en: For instance, tiny airborne nano-robots could be programmed to actually rebuild the ozone layer, which could lessen the impact of global warming on our planet.
sentences.zh: 例如，可以编程让微小的空中纳米机器人实际重建臭氧层，从而减轻全球变暖对我们星球的影响。

sentences.en: That's a pretty amazing thought, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真是一个令人惊叹的想法，不是吗？

sentences.en: On a more local scale, this new technology could help with the clean-up of environmental disasters as nanotechnology will allow us to remove oil and other contaminants from the water far more effectively.
sentences.zh: 在更局部的层面上，这项新技术可帮助清理环境灾难，因为纳米技术将使我们能更有效地从水中清除石油及其他污染物。

sentences.en: And, if nanotechnology progresses as expected - as a sort of building block set of about 90 atoms then you could build anything you wanted from the bottom up.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果纳米技术按预期发展——即以大约90个原子构成的‘积木组’为基础，那么人们就能自下而上地构建任何所需物品。

sentences.en: In terms of production, this means that you only use what you need and so there wouldn't be any waste.
sentences.zh: 就生产而言，这意味着只使用所需材料，因而不会产生任何浪费。

sentences.en: The notion that you could create anything at all has major implications for our health.
sentences.zh: 能够制造任何东西这一理念，将对我们的健康产生重大影响。

sentences.en: It means that we'll eventually be able to replicate anything.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们最终将能够复制任何物质。

sentences.en: This would have a phenomenal effect on our society.
sentences.zh: 这将对我们的社会产生深远影响。

sentences.en: In time it could even lead to the eradication of famine through the introduction of machines that produce food to feed the hungry.
sentences.zh: 长远来看，甚至可能通过引入生产食物以供养饥饿人群的机器，彻底消除饥荒。

sentences.en: But it's in the area of medicine that nanotechnology may have its biggest impact.
sentences.zh: 但纳米技术可能在医学领域产生最大的影响。

sentences.en: How we detect disease will change as tiny biosensors are developed to analyse tests in minutes rather than days.
sentences.zh: 随着微型生物传感器的开发，疾病检测方式将发生改变，分析测试的时间将从数天缩短至几分钟。

sentences.en: There's even speculation nano-robots could be used to slow the ageing process, lengthening life expectancy.
sentences.zh: 甚至有猜测认为，纳米机器人可用于延缓衰老过程，从而延长预期寿命。

sentences.en: As you can see, I'm very excited by the implications that could be available to us in the next few decades.
sentences.zh: 如您所见，我对未来几十年内可能出现的这些影响感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Just how long it'll take, I honestly don't know.
sentences.zh: 究竟需要多长时间，我确实无法确定。
